name: Flow.cl

webhook.algorithm: SORTED-PARAM HMAC, applied to BOTH directions. Every request and confirmation carries an `s` parameter: sort all params alphabetically by name, concatenate as name+value with no separators (e.g. `amount5000apiKeyXXXXcurrencyCLP`), then HMAC-SHA256 with your secretKey. NO timestamp is covered. Additionally the urlConfirmation POST delivers only a `token` — you MUST call payment/getStatus to obtain the real result. This is a ping-then-poll flow, not a trustworthy payload.

evidence.note: Catalog import from adversarially-checked research. The scheme above is quoted from that research and has NOT been transcribed into typed fields, so PagoKit will not generate a verifier. Promoting this provider to generic or build means reading the provider docs and typing the scheme in.

credentials.note: apiKey (sent in params) + secretKey (never sent, used only to compute `s`). No prefix pattern documented. Sandbox at sandbox.flow.cl with separate credentials.

notes: The self-serve Chilean alternative to Transbank's direct contract — a developer can sign up and ship in a day, which Transbank onboarding does not allow. Aggregates Webpay, Servipag and bank transfer behind one API.
SDKs: Official code examples for PHP, Node and Python are published in the docs; community packages exist. Not a full first-party SDK story.
Developer-experience scores are unrated placeholders (3/3); they are not used in ranking.
Overlaps: Complements transbank — Flow is faster to onboard, Transbank is cheaper at volume and is what Flow ultimately routes card traffic through.
Onboarding model was inferred during the catalog import and is not verified. Confirm it before relying on the "can this user actually get keys" filter.
